name: Courage for a Kiss
source:
Ryan has led an uneventful life so far. Everything changes in his penultimate year of high school, when his classmate, shy Evelyn, hears about writing and acting contest.

Together they host a casting call, in which they meet cheerful Stella, clumsy Amelia, and asocial Jennifer.

Can they prepare an original stage play and win the national contest? Will they find love along the way?

Find out in this romantic Visual Novel with a touch of comedy and drama!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/960590/Courage_for_a_Kiss/]Steam[/url]]
